Hi Alex / Procurement team,

Thanks again for moving quickly here. We'd like to schedule a 60-minute kickoff to align legal/procurement, security, and engineering so we can get vendor onboarding started. Proposed goals:
- Confirm procurement checklist and contract owner(s)
- Walk security questionnaire scope (SOC2, data flows)
- Technical intro: SE to review network/connectivity and demo scope
- Agree on timelines & next steps (DocuSign, evidence handoff)

Please let us know which of these slots work on your side (PST):
- Tue 2026-09-01 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2026-09-01 15:00–16:00
- Wed 2026-09-02 09:00–10:00

I've CC'd David (SE) and Laura (CS lead) — we'll own the technical & onboarding checklist. If there are other stakeholders (security, legal), please add them.

Prework: we'll attach our onboarding checklist and SOC2 excerpt after you confirm a slot.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

Hi Grace — thanks. 10am PST on Tue 9/1 works for me (Alex Reynolds). I've added Sara Kim from our InfoSec and our procurement mailbox for contract tracking. A couple quick asks before the call:

1) Can you share SOC2 evidence (or a redacted excerpt) and high-level network/access requirements so our infra team can triage before the meeting?

I'll prepare a short procurement intake form and send it to you tomorrow.

Alex / Sara / Procurement team — forwarding a few items so you have context ahead of Tuesday's 10:00am PST kickoff:

   - 10:00–10:10 Introductions / success criteria (Grace + Alex)
   - 10:10–10:25 Security & compliance expectations (Sara / Redwood sec lead)
   - 10:25–10:40 Technical connectivity & demo (David)
   - 10:40–10:55 Procurement checklist / contractual path (Laura)
   - 10:55–11:00 Next steps & owners

2) Quick pre-reads attached:
   - SOC2_report_redwood.pdf (redacted controls summary) [Attachment]
   - network_requirements_matrix.xlsx (ports, IP ranges, SSO configuration) [Attachment]

If the 10:00 slot ends up conflicting for your security reviewer, we can move to the 3pm slot — lmk.

Thanks,
